title: brokerctl refuses to start: 'insufficient space, another instance may be running'
description_md:
The `eventqueue` broker is down and won't come back up. Every attempt to start it with `brokerctl start` refuses, saying something like 'only 2MB free ... a WAL reservation is already present, assuming another instance is still using it' -- but nothing is actually running. The box lost power mid-run last night. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out whether that reservation is real, reclaim the space it's holding, and get the broker running.

You're done when `eventqueue-worker` is actually running and there's healthy free space in `/var/lib/eventqueue` again.
